parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a lightweight plastic cover that closes over the seat. It is typically made of polypropylene for durability and ease of cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the toilet bowl when not in use, preventing odors and maintaining hygiene.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged at the back and can rotate upward or downward around the hinge axis.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat is the ring-shaped part of the toilet that users sit on. It is made of smooth, durable plastic for comfort and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and stable surface for sitting while using the toilet.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged at the back, allowing it to lift up or down independently of the lid.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic component located on the top of the tank, used to activate the flushing mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It triggers the flush valve inside the tank, releasing water into the bowl for cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main ceramic structure of the toilet, including the bowl and tank. It is made of vitreous china for strength and water resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and connected to the water supply and drainage system.
